_comment: Worklist for the InfluxDB v1 shared-content migration. Each entry is a page that still exists as two copies (OSS v1 and Enterprise v1) and is intended to become shared content. CI fails if a pull request increases the divergence between a pair. Remove an entry only when its page actually moves to content/shared/influxdb-v1/ -- the check unions this list with the base ref's, so deleting an entry cannot by itself take a pair out of comparison. Do not delete this file while any v1 page is still duplicated across editions; an empty list means the next batch has not been enumerated, not that the work is done.
